title: Auto-park and parking assistance behavior
summary: Feedback centers on auto-park and parking-related automation, with one helpful surround-view comment, some complaints about usability and parking behavior, and several fragments that only mention automatic functions without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: The positive review says the surround-view feature helps when parking.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe auto-park as too complicated for simple spaces and criticize how quickly the vehicle moves when trying to park.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention automatic parking prompts, auto-park availability, and other automatic switching behavior without enough context to confirm sentiment or even the same subtopic.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, limiting confidence about clear customer sentiment on auto-park.
The cluster mixes parking assistance with unrelated automatic switching behaviors, such as engine shutoff and seat heating, so it is not fully coherent.
Some fragments are too brief to tell whether they describe a praise, complaint, or simple feature mention.
